content.description:
CardanoApes is the first project on Cardano that combines NFTs and 3D assets. Since we revealed our efforts to the public, the wider Cardano community has been extremely empowering which motivated our team even more. Without the believers and risk takers who invested into CardanoApes in the earliest stages, we couldn’t have grown the ape community to this size. It has been an incredible journey so far and we want to build a community-driven narrative that stands the test of time.

Over $200,000 of our last sale going RIGHT BACK to our community. COMMUNITY FIRST! We LOVE our primate family and want to cause more rumble in the jungle with you all for life.
